info.name: Traktor Kontrol S5
info.author: openDJ
info.description: openDJ's partial HID mapping for the Traktor Kontrol S5: two deck sections played as in Traktor (effect units, hot cue, slicer and sample pads, touch strips, transport) and the four-channel mixer. Written from an incomplete published HID report layout: the browse and loop encoders and channel D's LOW and FILTER knobs don't do anything yet. Its displays stay dark.
